778-five-children-and-it.title: Five Children and It
778-five-children-and-it.creator: E. Nesbit*
778-five-children-and-it.description: A book by E. Nesbit*. We produce about two million dollars for each hour we work. The fifty hours is one conservative estimate for how long it we take to get any etext selected, entered, proofread, edited, copyright searched and analyzed, the copyright letters written, etc. This projected audience is one hundred million readers.

arxiv-2102-04660.title: Trustless, privacy-preserving blockchain bridges
arxiv-2102-04660.creator: Drew Stone
arxiv-2102-04660.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a protocol for facilitating trust-less cross-chain cryptocurrency transfers that preserve privacy of bridge withdrawals. We leverage zero-knowledge primitives that are commonly used to design cryptocurrency mixing protocols to provide similar functionality but across two or more blockchains.

arxiv-2303-01501.title: Stability and Machine Learning Applications of Persistent Homology Using the Delaunay-Rips Complex
arxiv-2303-01501.creator: Amish Mishra and Francis C. Motta
arxiv-2303-01501.description: Abstract In this paper we define, implement, and investigate a simplicial complex construction for computing persistent homology of Euclidean point cloud data, which we call the Delaunay-Rips complex (DR). Assigning the Vietoris-Rips weights to simplices, DR experiences speed-up in the persistence calculations by only considering simplices that appear in the Delaunay triangulation of the point cloud.

arxiv-2310-04191.title: Zones of quiet in a broadband diffuse sound field
arxiv-2310-04191.creator: Boaz Rafaely
arxiv-2310-04191.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Boaz Rafaely. The zones of quiet in pure-tone diffuse sound fields have been studied extensively in the past, both theoretically and experimentally, with the well known result of the 10 dB attenuation extending to about a tenth of a wavelength. Recent results on the spatial-temporal correlation of broadband diffuse sound fields are used in this study to develop a theoretical framework for predicting the extension of the zones of quiet in broadband diffuse sound fields.

arxiv-2312-06568.title: Sparse but Strong: Crafting Adversarially Robust Graph Lottery Tickets
arxiv-2312-06568.creator: Subhajit Dutta Chowdhury, Zhiyu Ni, Qingyuan Peng, Souvik Kundu, Pierluigi Nuzzo
arxiv-2312-06568.description: Abstract Graph Lottery Tickets (GLTs), comprising a sparse adjacency matrix and a sparse graph neural network (GNN), can significantly reduce the inference latency and compute footprint compared to their dense counterparts. Despite these benefits, their performance against adversarial structure perturbations remains to be fully explored.

arxiv-2405-05593.title: Periodic Solutions in a Simple Delay Differential Equation
arxiv-2405-05593.creator: Anatoli Ivanov, Sergiy Shelyag
arxiv-2405-05593.description: Abstract Simple form scalar differential equation with delay and nonlinear negative periodic feedback is considered. The existence of several types of slowly oscillating periodic solutions is shown with the same and double periods of the feedback coefficient. The periodic solutions are built explicitly in the case of piecewise constant nonlinearities involved.

arxiv-2406-02432.title: Coresets for Multiple ℓ p \ell_{p} Regression
arxiv-2406-02432.creator: David P. Woodruff, Taisuke Yasuda
arxiv-2406-02432.description: Abstract A coreset of a dataset with n n examples and d d features is a weighted subset of examples that is sufficient for solving downstream data analytic tasks. Nearly optimal constructions of coresets for least squares and ℓ p \ell_{p} linear regression with a single response are known in prior work.

arxiv-2502-20433.title: Aeos : The Impact of Population III Initial Mass Function and Star-by-Star Models in Galaxy Simulations
arxiv-2502-20433.creator: Kaley Brauer, Jennifer Mead, John H. Wise, Greg L. Bryan, Mordecai-Mark Mac Low, Alexander P. Ji, Andrew Emerick, Eric P. Andersson, Anna Frebel, Benoit Côté
arxiv-2502-20433.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kaley Brauer, Jennifer Mead, John H. Wise, Greg L. Bryan, Mordecai-Mark Mac Low, Alexander P. Ji, Andrew Emerick, Eric P. Andersson, Anna Frebel, Benoit Côté. We explore the effect of variations in the Population III (Pop III) initial mass function (IMF) and star-by-star feedback on early galaxy formation and evolution using the A eos simulations.

arxiv-2504-14573.title: Modality Selection and Skill Segmentation via Cross-Modality Attention
arxiv-2504-14573.creator: Jiawei Jiang 1, Kei Ota 2, Devesh K. Jha 3, and Asako Kanezaki 1, Jiawei Jiang Science Tokyo, Kei Ota Mitsubishi Electric, Devesh K. Jha MERL, Asako Kanezaki Science Tokyo
arxiv-2504-14573.description: Abstract \finalcopy Abstract Incorporating additional sensory modalities such as tactile and audio into foundational robotic models poses significant challenges due to the curse of dimensionality. This work addresses this issue through modality selection. We propose a cross-modality attention (CMA) mechanism to identify and selectively utilize the modalities that are most informative for action generation at each timestep.

arxiv-2509-26177.title: Benchmarking Diarization Models
arxiv-2509-26177.creator: Luca A. Lanzendörfer, Florian Grötschla, Cesare Blaser, Roger Wattenhofer
arxiv-2509-26177.description: Abstract Speaker diarization is the task of partitioning audio into segments according to speaker identity, answering the question of “who spoke when” in multi-speaker conversation recordings. While diarization is an essential task for many downstream applications, it remains an unsolved problem. Errors in diarization propagate to downstream systems and cause wide-ranging failures.

arxiv-2510-26517.title: The ϕ ​ p \phi p bound state in the unitary coupled-channel approximation
arxiv-2510-26517.creator: Qin-Qin Cao
arxiv-2510-26517.description: Abstract The attractive interaction of the ϕ \phi meson and the proton is reported by the ALICE Collaboration, and the corresponding scattering length f 0 f_{0} is given as R ​ e ​ ( f 0 ) = 0.85 ± 0.34 ​ ( s ​ t ​ a ​ t ) ± 0.

arxiv-2511-01021.title: Extension of p p -compact operators in Banach spaces
arxiv-2511-01021.creator: Sainik Karak, Tanmoy Paul
arxiv-2511-01021.description: Abstract . We analyze various consequences in relation to the extension of operators T : X → Y T:X\to Y that are p p -compact, as well as the extension of operators T : X → Y T:X\to Y whose adjoints T ∗ : Y ∗ → X ∗ T^{*}:Y^{*}\to X^{*} are p p -compact.

pmc-10750645.title: Intramedullary vs Plate Fixation of Distal Fibular Fractures: Use Rates, Fracture Patterns, Patient Characteristics, and Complication Rates
pmc-10750645.creator: Douglas Zhang, Nicholas Lin, Sean Pirkle, Jason Strelzow, Kelly Hynes
pmc-10750645.description: Category:Trauma; AnkleIntroduction/Purpose:The traditional surgical treatment for distal fibula fractures is open reduction and plate fixation (PF). However, intramedullary fixation (IMF) has been shown to provide advantages over plate fixation, particularly in patients and injuries with higher risks of soft tissue complications. Current evidence comparing the two fixation types remains scarce and is limited by modest sample sizes.

pmc-11503040.title: Digital ray: enhancing cataractous fundus images using style transfer generative adversarial networks to improve retinopathy detection
pmc-11503040.creator: Lixue Liu, Jiaming Hong, Yuxuan Wu, Shaopeng Liu, Kai Wang, Mingyuan Li, Lanqin Zhao, Zhenzhen Liu, Longhui Li, Tingxin Cui, Ching-Kit Tsui, Fabao Xu, Weiling Hu, Dongyuan Yun, Xi Chen, Yuanjun Shang, Shaowei Bi, Xiaoyue Wei, Yunxi Lai, Duoru Lin, Zhe Fu, Yaru Deng, Kaimin Cai, Yi Xie, Zizheng Cao,
pmc-11503040.description: Background/aimsThe aim of this study was to develop and evaluate digital ray, based on preoperative and postoperative image pairs using style transfer generative adversarial networks (GANs), to enhance cataractous fundus images for improved retinopathy detection.MethodsFor eligible cataract patients, preoperative and postoperative colour fundus photographs (CFP) and ultra-wide field (UWF) images were captured.

pmc-11558057.title: Acute tolerance to rocuronium -A case report-
pmc-11558057.creator: Jong Ho Kim, Sang joon Park, Youngsuk Kwon, Sung Mi Hwang, Hong Seuk Yang
pmc-11558057.description: BackgroundA booster dose can result in a similar reaction to the initial dose. Neuromuscular blocking agents (NMBAs) can produce a comparable reaction in the absence of specific pathophysiologic alterations.CaseAn initial dose of rocuronium 40 mg was given to a male patient (50 years old, height 168 cm, weight 54 kg, body mass index 19.13 kg/m2) for anesthesia.

pmc-11632386.creator: Jessica S. Clothier, Andrew Harding, Jonathan Praeger, Serge Kobsa, Sanjeet Patel, Ajay Vaidya, Anahat Dhillon, Amy Hackmann, Craig Baker, Mark Barr, Vaughn Starnes, Raymond Lee

pmc-11725341.title: Dyshidrosiform Bullous Pemphigoid: A Palmar Variant of a Common Disease
pmc-11725341.creator: Alexa Lum, Mitchell Brady
pmc-11725341.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Dyshidrosiform bullous pemphigoid (DBP) is a rare variant of bullous pemphigoid (BP) that mainly affects elderly patients and presents with tense bullae formation on the palms, soles, or both palms and soles. This case report describes an 87-year-old woman who was evaluated in the hospital for a month-long erythematous and pruritic rash on most of her body that eventually manifested into tense blisters on the palms.

pmc-12615650.title: Piezocatalytic activity of bismuth vanadium titanium oxide
pmc-12615650.creator: Aditya Singh Thakur, Shivam Dubey, Amal Abdulrahman, Mohamed A Ismail, Abdelfattah Amari, Rahul Vaish
pmc-12615650.description: This study reveals piezocatalytic activity of Bi4V1.5Ti0.5O10.85 ceramic powder using Rhodamine B (RhB) dye. Bi4V1.5Ti0.5O10.85 ceramic powder was fabricated via solid state reaction method. The fabricated ferroelectric ceramic was characterized by X-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and Scanning electron microscopy. The band gap for Bi4V1.5Ti0.5O10.85 was calculated to be 2.25 eV using Tauc’s plot.

pmc-12658231.title: Mesh-like structure integrated core-shell-shell nanocomposites for enhanced stability and performance in carbon capture
pmc-12658231.creator: Sizhuo Yang, Haiyan Mao, Chaochao Dun, Jianfang Liu, Kaipeng Hou, Angela Cai, Jing Wang, Jane K J Lee, Donglin Li, Hao Lyu, Zhouyi Chen, Xudong Lv, Hao Zhuang, Xueer Xu, Xueli Zheng, Gang Ren, Jeffrey A Reimer, Yi Cui, Jeffrey J Urban
pmc-12658231.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Carbon capture is essential for mitigating climate change, yet most sorbents struggle to combine high capacity with chemical stability. Here we report core-shell-shell (CSS) nanocomposites that integrate adsorption efficiency with exceptional robustness. The design couples a metal-organic framework (MOF) core, which enriches local CO2 concentration, with a polyamine shell that is reorganized into a porous, ordered network through entanglement with an outer covalent organic framework (COF) shell.

pmc-13267993.title: Clinical and Angiographic Predictors of No‐Reflow and Its Impact on Outcomes in ST‐Elevation Myocardial Infarction: A Retrospective Study
pmc-13267993.creator: Husnain Bashir, F N U Berkha, Jahanzeb Malik, Abida Perveen
pmc-13267993.description: ObjectiveTo identify clinical and angiographic predictors of the no‐reflow phenomenon and evaluate its impact on short‐ and long‐term outcomes in patients undergoing primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) for ST‐elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI).MethodsThis retrospective study included 2925 patients who underwent primary PCI for STEMI between January 2020 and July 2025.

pmc-13428129.title: Synchronized left anterior/posterior fasciculars pacing - a modified strategy for difficult left ventricular lead implantation during CRT-D: A case report
pmc-13428129.creator: Yao-Zong Guan, Tang Zhang, Huan-Jie Huang, De-Sheng Lu, Hao Liu
pmc-13428129.description: Cardiac resynchronization therapy - defibrillator (CRT-D) is an effective treatment for ischemic heart failure (HF). But, it is a tricky challenge for left ventricular lead implantation difficulties during CRT-D. We report an ischemic cardiomyopathy patient with complete right bundle branch block (cRBBB) underwent CRT-D.

pmc-13556404.title: 68. Predicting executive dysfunction in mood disorders using a multimodal machine learning approach
pmc-13556404.creator: J-W Lai, Y-M Bai, Y-H Hu, R-Y Wu, C-C Shen
pmc-13556404.description: BackgroundMood disorders are often accompanied by persistent cognitive impairment, even during remission. Recent advances in computational psychiatry may serve as digital biomarkers of cognition.Aims & ObjectivesThis study aimed to develop machine learning models using multimodal features derived from patients’ spontaneous speech, to predict executive function.

pmc-13578358.title: Deterministic and ANN-based modelling of measles transmission using real epidemiological data
pmc-13578358.creator: Kamil Shah, Changqing Du, Ali Akgül, Farad Sameer Alshammari, Sanaa Ahmed Bajri, Hamiden Abd El-Wahed Khalifa
pmc-13578358.description: This study aims to develop a nonlinear SVLIQR epidemic model to investigate measles transmission dynamics by incorporating vaccination, latency, quarantine, and treatment effects. The qualitative properties of the model, including positivity and boundedness of solutions, are established. The basic reproduction number is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the existence of disease-free and endemic equilibrium points is examined.
